starting_rules: No old LST-224 hit, named submarine loss or other legacy ship result is inherited.
Cabot cripple-hunt consumed 1-2 boat-days before the assault-lane network reached full density.
No real-time wolfpack control; contact/report/attack remain separate decisions.
Sentaka sprint is tactical geometry correction only.
US ASW is alert after GALVANIC, the 2-Feb carrier battle and repeated submarine reports.

4Feb_submarine_state.event: One northern boat approaches a CVE/fire-support screen during 4-Feb but aircraft/escort handoff forces it deep before a satisfactory shot.

4_5Feb_night_air.source: Already-counted surviving Marshall attack aircraft using water-recon/submarine cue; not a reinforcement package.
4_5Feb_night_air.center_result: No US ship hit. Radar pickets, CAP, maneuver and target-identification uncertainty break the attack.

5Feb_submarine_attack.geometry: A conventional I/Ro-class boat uses the now-better-defined southern assault/tractor corridor and obtains a firing-quality solution against a dense landing echelon after the outer DD screen has been partially drawn into close-support/approach duties.
5Feb_submarine_attack.center_result: One torpedo hits an LST-class landing ship. The hull remains afloat but is mission-killed for the main assault and withdrawn/towed from the immediate landing package; exact hull identity remains OPEN.
5Feb_submarine_attack.cargo_guard: Do not invent the exact embarked tank/LVT/company cargo. Some vehicles/stores become inaccessible or are lost, but no named tank company or regiment is deleted by fiat.
5Feb_submarine_attack.operational_effect: Reduces tractor/landing-ship reserve margin and adds local redistribution work. It does not stop a division-scale assault and is less severe than the superseded LST-224 constructive-total-loss line.
5Feb_submarine_attack.attacker: Survives the immediate counterattack centered but is mission-damaged and withdraws; unavailable for another pre-D-Day shot.

5Feb_ASW_attrition.event: A different conventional boat attempts to re-enter a central/northern support screen during daylight/early evening and is prosecuted by escort sonar plus aircraft.
5Feb_ASW_attrition.center_result: One conventional Japanese submarine sunk; exact hull identity remains OPEN because the branch patrol geometry no longer matches historical attribution.
5Feb_ASW_attrition.note: The count can resemble an older line, but the event path, target interaction and hull identity are independently rerun.

5_6Feb_predawn_air.role: harassment/recon/last-chance transport cue rather than a coherent strike
5_6Feb_predawn_air.center_result: No ship hit; 1 aircraft irrecoverable centered.

net_through_5FebT24.US: One unnamed LST-class hull mission-killed and removed from the assault package; no CVE/APA/battleship hit centered.
net_through_5FebT24.Japan: One conventional submarine sunk, one mission-damaged/withdrawn from the successful LST attack, remaining network pushed outward but still reporting.
net_through_5FebT24.information: Japanese command retains high confidence in 6-Feb-class assault timing/sector concentration; US ASW pressure prevents converting that knowledge into repeated weapon-quality attacks.
